rituals.name: Amity Cycle
rituals.notes: You perform an anbarit, which involves poetry reading, singing, music, and dancing.

rituals.name: Angelic Messenger
rituals.notes: You transport yourself to either a celestial plane or a world on the Universe where worshippers of your patron can be found.
rituals.primaryCheck: Religion (expert; you must be an angel )

rituals.name: Animate Object
rituals.notes: You transform the target into an animated object with a level up to that allowed by the Creature Creation Rituals table and of a type corresponding to the object (so a broom would become an animated broom).
rituals.cost: rare oils, see Creature Creation Rituals

rituals.name: Antimagic Artifice
rituals.notes: You anoint a seemingly harmless item with the power to disrupt magic.
rituals.cost: reagents and oils worth a total value of 4,500 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion (whichever is used for the primary check) and Warfare Lore
rituals.target: one inanimate object of 1 Bulk or less

rituals.name: Arcane Weaving
rituals.notes: You and the secondary casters weave together spells in a complex ritual that combines magical learning with art, allowing all the participants to share spells they know with one another.
rituals.cost: rare silks worth a total value of 20 gp × the spell level

rituals.name: Army of Shadows
rituals.notes: You conjure a squadron of shadows to surge forth and plunge your enemies into darkness.

rituals.name: Ash-Strewn Ending
rituals.notes: Lo, speak of the hero-gods and their ash-strewn endings!

rituals.name: Asmodean Wager
rituals.notes: You facilitate a magically binding agreement between yourself and one or more secondary casters
rituals.cost: parchment, ink, and an item of value from each bettor worth at least 50 gp

rituals.name: Astral Projection
rituals.notes: You project the targets’ spiritual essences into the Astral Plane , leaving their inanimate physical forms behind.
rituals.cost: one gem worth a total value of the target’s level (minimum 1) × 5 gp, for each target
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (whichever isn’t used for the primary check), Survival
rituals.target: yourself and up to 5 willing creatures

rituals.name: Atone
rituals.notes: You attempt to help a truly penitent creature atone for its misdeeds, typically actions that are anathema to your deity.
rituals.cost: rare incense and offerings worth a total value of 20 gp × the target’s level
rituals.secondaryCheck: Nature or Religion (whichever is used for the primary check)
rituals.target: another creature of up to 8th level who is a worshipper of the same deity or philosophy as you

rituals.name: Awaken Animal
rituals.notes: You grant intelligence to the target, transforming it into a beast.
rituals.cost: herbs, 1/5 the value on Creature Creation Rituals
rituals.target: 1 animal of up to the level on the table

rituals.name: Awaken Curse
rituals.notes: You siphon a tiny portion of life force from each of the ritual's casters to empower a curse against disrupting effects.

rituals.name: Awaken Object
rituals.notes: You imbue a single Small or smaller object with rudimentary awareness and consciousness.
rituals.cost: crushed gems and spices worth 250 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Crafting , Arcana or Occultism (whichever isn't used for the primary check)

rituals.name: Awaken Portal
rituals.notes: You attempt to reactivate a dormant gate, portal, or teleportation circle by infusing it with magical energies.
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (whichever is used for the primary check)

rituals.name: Bacchanalia
rituals.notes: You hold an elaborate feast and stoke the celebratory spirit, causing it to spread to other people nearby
rituals.cost: a lavish meal with expensive alcohol for every caster (225 gp)

rituals.name: Band Of Heroes
rituals.notes: The sun rises on a gathering of heroes bonded to a cause.

rituals.name: Bathe In Blood
rituals.notes: This old ritual is illegal in nearly every corner of Golarion and requires that you submerge yourself in a bath of alchemically treated blood, attended by silent servants.
rituals.cost: alchemical herbs and components worth a total of 1,000 gp × the target’s level
rituals.target: 1 living creature of a level no greater than double the bathe in blood ritual's rank

rituals.name: Binding Circle
rituals.notes: You call forth an extraplanar creature of a level no greater than double that of the binding circle ritual’s rank and attempt to bargain with it, generally to perform a task for you in exchange for payment.
rituals.cost: warding circle ingredients worth a total value of 2 gp × the spell rank × the target’s level
rituals.secondaryCheck: Diplomacy or Intimidation ; Arcana or Occultism (whichever isn’t used for the primary check)

rituals.name: Blight
rituals.notes: You twist and stunt plants in the area, causing them to wither.

rituals.name: Blunt the Final Blade
rituals.notes: You anoint the final blade with powdered mithral and grave dirt while speaking softly and carefully to the souls trapped within it.
rituals.cost: powdered mithral and rare grave dirt worth 10,000 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana , Crafting , Society , and the other skill not used in the primary check

rituals.name: Bonding Meal
rituals.notes: Many grow up and spend their lives eating with others, and doing so binds them—to their families, communities, and cultures.
rituals.cost: 10 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Cooking Lore , Crafting , Performance , or Survival (trained)

rituals.name: Borrow Time
rituals.notes: This spell suspends time around you and the secondary casters, creating an opaque bubble where you can continue your work.
rituals.cost: bells, hourglasses, and water clocks worth a total of 1,000 gp

rituals.name: Bountiful Oasis
rituals.notes: You redirect the flow of underground lakes and other nearby sources of water to cause a lush natural spring to emerge from the ground.
rituals.cost: 3 drops of fresh water taken from a naturally occurring lake within 1,000 miles of the ritual site

rituals.name: Butterfly Bender
rituals.notes: Sometimes, the problems in your life are too oppressive.
rituals.cost: Alcohol worth a total of 20 gp x the ritual level

rituals.name: Call Spirit
rituals.notes: You tear the veil to the afterlife and call a spirit from its final resting place.
rituals.cost: rare candles and incense worth a total value of 50 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Occultism or Religion (whichever isn’t used for the primary check)

rituals.name: City Of Sin
rituals.notes: Each day during the casting of this ritual, intelligent creatures within range become increasingly prone to shed their inhibitions and give in to whatever tempts them.

rituals.name: Clone
rituals.notes: You collect hair, nail clippings, and samples of skin and blood from the target, who must be present throughout the ritual and can be one of the casters.
rituals.cost: rare laboratory supplies and reagents worth the target’s level (minimum 1) × 100 gp
rituals.target: 1 willing living creature up to 20th level

rituals.name: Cloudborne Haven
rituals.notes: The land beneath the building breaks away, lifting the structure up to half a mile off the ground.
rituals.cost: a replica keystone of the target building crafted from quartz worth 4,500 gp
rituals.target: 1 building up to 500 feet by 500 feet

rituals.name: Collective Memories
rituals.notes: You tap into other mortals’ memories, knowledge, legends, tales, and lore about a subject.
rituals.cost: rare incense worth a total value of 300 gp

rituals.name: Commune
rituals.notes: You call upon an unknown, powerful being to answer questions.
rituals.cost: rare incense worth a total value of 150 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Nature, Occultism, or Religion (whichever is used for the primary check)

rituals.name: Commune With Corazal
rituals.notes: You tap into Corazal’s innumerable senses to identify disturbances throughout the Verduran Forest.
rituals.secondaryCheck: DC 24 Forest Lore , Perception , or Survival

rituals.name: Community Repair
rituals.notes: You lead your community in repairing a public work, such as a bridge, well, or mural, through the power of memory and art.
rituals.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
rituals.cost: rare powdered pigments in at least three different colors, worth a total of 50 gp
rituals.target: 1 damaged or broken public work no larger than 3,000 cubic feet (the size of a Huge creature)

rituals.name: Concealment's Curtain
rituals.notes: Curse the target such that they are unable to see you in any way.
rituals.cost: an ornate mirror worth at least 100 gp, naturally occurring round fruit the size and number of the target's eyes, and the same amount of flawless silver needles worth at least 1 gp each

rituals.name: Concealments's Curtain
rituals.notes: The target is can’t visually detect any of the casters involved in the ritual
rituals.cost: an ornate mirror worth at least 100 gp, naturally occurring round fruit the size and number of the target’s eyes, and the same amount of flawless silver needles worth at least 1 gp each

rituals.name: Confound the Eye and Confuse the Mind
rituals.notes: With a flash, you obscure spellcasting to confound observers.
rituals.cost: costumes, props, and reagents, plus cloth worth a total value of 10 gp × the target’s level
rituals.target: 1 creature of a level no greater than double the ritual’s rank who can cast spells

rituals.name: Consecrate
rituals.notes: You consecrate a site to your deity, chanting praises and creating a sacred space.
rituals.cost: rare incense and offerings worth a total value of 20 gp × the spell rank

rituals.name: Construct Mindscape
rituals.notes: You create an entirely mental environment called an immersive mindscape .
rituals.cost: precious clay, wood, or other modeling materials worth spell level × 20 gp

rituals.name: Contact Friends
rituals.notes: You meditate for a quiet moment before your mind seeks out others whom you have befriended.
rituals.cost: incense worth 50 gp

rituals.name: Control Weather
rituals.notes: You alter the weather, making it calm and normal for the season or choosing up to two effects based on the season.

rituals.name: Corpse Communion
rituals.notes: The dead hold more secrets than the living ever shall.
rituals.cost: rare spices and seasonings worth a total value of 50 gp × the spell level

rituals.name: Create Demiplane
rituals.notes: Few incantations are as renowned as the power to create worlds.
rituals.cost: precious materials worth a total value of 800 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana, Nature, Occultism, Religion (whichever three aren’t used for the primary check)

rituals.name: Create Skinstitch
rituals.notes: You transform the target into a skinstitch, a hideous construct covered in the flesh of sentient humanoids.
rituals.cost: rare oils worth 480 gp
rituals.target: 1 frame covered in the skin of sentient humanoids

rituals.name: Create Undead
rituals.notes: You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in the Creature Creation Rituals table.
rituals.cost: black onyx, see Creature Creation Rituals

rituals.name: Curse Of Calamity
rituals.notes: You condemn your targets to violent misfortune.

rituals.name: Daemonic Pact
rituals.notes: You attempt to conjure daemons to assist you.
rituals.primaryCheck: Religion (expert; you must be a daemon or an urdefhan )

rituals.name: Demonic Pact
rituals.notes: You attempt to conjure other demons to assist you.
rituals.primaryCheck: Religion (expert; you must be a demon )

rituals.name: Diabolic Pact
rituals.notes: You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service.
rituals.primaryCheck: Religion (expert; you must be a devil )

rituals.name: Div Pact
rituals.notes: You call upon the powers of Abaddon to grant you the assistance of a div.
rituals.primaryCheck: Religion (expert; you must be a div )

rituals.name: Divine Keystone
rituals.notes: You magically remove and consecrate the cornerstone of a building or ruin in the center of a settlement before returning the stone to its structure to spread its divine protection into the settlement around it.
rituals.cost: holy water,powdered silver, and purified chalk worth 200 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Architecture Lore , Crafting , or Engineering Lore

rituals.name: Drain Planar Connection
rituals.notes: You draw the planar energy from Idyllis, through the ley lines , and into the six latticework spheres.
rituals.cost: six sets of rare herbs, each worth a total of 50 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Secondary Checks DC 26 Diplomacy or Nature or Occultism

rituals.name: Dread Ambience
rituals.notes: In some places, it feels as if the very land doesn’t want you there.
rituals.cost: candles, specialty salts, and rare herbs worth 80 gp total

rituals.name: Elemental Sentinel
rituals.notes: You place a tiny elemental wisp within an object.
rituals.cost: precious metals, rare incense, and herbs worth a total value of 15 gp per spell rank

rituals.name: Elemental Servitor
rituals.notes: You implore an elemental lord to send an elemental servitor of the lord's choice, with a level no greater than double the ritual's spell rank.
rituals.cost: rare items and offerings worth a total value of 2 gp × the spell rank × the target's level, see text for more details

rituals.name: Embodied Font
rituals.notes: You place the magic items into a neat pile and attempt to draw out their power to form a new body that the target can inhabit.
rituals.cost: magic items with a value of at least 2,000 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: skill corresponding to the target’s casting tradition (trained)
rituals.target: the disembodied wildspell associated with the primary caster

rituals.name: Empower Ley Line
rituals.notes: You draw upon surrounding magical energy to empower a ley line, enhancing both its positive and negative effects.
rituals.cost: magical foci worth a total value of 50 gp × the spell level × the target's level
rituals.primaryCheck: Arcana , Nature , Occultism , or Religion , matching the ley line's tradition (legendary)
rituals.target: 1 ley line or ley line node up to double this ritual's level

rituals.name: Encroaching Woods
rituals.notes: You entreat the spirits of a nearby wood to cloak the movements of you and your allies.

rituals.name: Entreat Thunderbird
rituals.notes: You entreat the thunderbird in the Tusk Mountains to come to your aid.
rituals.cost: rare incense and offerings worth 300 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Diplomacy , Mountain Lore , Nature, or Survival

rituals.name: Establish Nexus
rituals.notes: You focus the power of the node's intersecting ley lines into a powerful confluent point known as a ley line nexus.
rituals.cost: magical foci worth 100 gp × the spell level × the node's level
rituals.primaryCheck: Arcana , Nature , Occultism , or Religion based on the ley line (master)
rituals.target: 1 ley line node up to double establish nexus's level

rituals.name: Extract Brain
rituals.notes: You perform a complex magical operation on a willing or restrained creature or a corpse, delicately cutting into the skull and removing the creature's brain without damaging the organ
rituals.cost: fine surgical tools and rare preservative salts and fluids worth a total value of 100 gp
rituals.target: 1 Large or smaller creature or corpse

rituals.name: Fantastic Facade
rituals.notes: You draw a permanent series of complex illusions over the target settlement, choosing the look, sound, feel, and smell of the structures, terrain, and creatures within at the time the ritual is cast.
rituals.cost: mystical paint, elaborate veils, and powdered minerals worth 20,000 gp total

rituals.name: Feast of Supplication
rituals.notes: When mortals attempt to sway gods, spirits, and other beings of great spiritual power to take sides in mortal affairs, those powers demand to be impressed.
rituals.cost: 25 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Cooking Lore , Crafting , Performance or Survival (expert)

rituals.name: Fey Abeyance
rituals.notes: You ward an area with cold iron bells, protecting it from the influence of the first world.
rituals.cost: rare oils, cold iron bells worth at least 5 gp

rituals.name: Footholds and Foothills
rituals.notes: The physical world resists changes, but this can be subdued like any other foe.

rituals.name: Form of the Sandpoint Devil
rituals.notes: You infuse yourself with incredible amounts of pure evil, subsuming your consciousness into malevolence and giving yourself a monstrous form resembling that of the Sandpoint Devil.
rituals.cost: igneous stones and gems worth 1,500 gp, bat wings, horse hooves, and at least one lizard

rituals.name: Fortifying Brew
rituals.notes: You craft a large quantity of restorative drink, such as an invigorating tea, a refreshing ale, or a stimulative alchemical tonic.
rituals.cost: high-quality ingredients and brewing equipment worth 25 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Alcohol Lore (or related lore), Crafting , Society

rituals.name: Freedom
rituals.notes: You perform a ritual to free a creature imprisoned, petrified , or otherwise put into stasis by any magical effects.
rituals.cost: valuable oils and objects associated with the target worth a total value of 100 gp × the spell rank × the target’s level

rituals.name: Garden of Death
rituals.notes: A successful ritual draws every possible poisonous plant or animal native to the surrounding environment into its area, forming a stable ecosystem, with nonpoisonous plants or animals growing only if there’s no toxic counterpart.
rituals.cost: water infused with drops of the primary caster’s blood and a dozen deadly toxins worth a total of 50 gp

rituals.name: Gathering Call
rituals.notes: You bind yourself and your allies to the specific safe location, referred to as a sanctuary, where you perform the ritual.
rituals.cost: rare oils and powdered minerals worth 5,000 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (expert, the check has the secret trait)
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (whichever isn’t used for the primary check), Society
rituals.target: up to seven willing creatures of 14th level or lower

rituals.name: Geas
rituals.notes: You enforce a magic rule on a willing target, forcing it to either perform or refrain from carrying out a certain act.
rituals.target: 1 creature of a level no greater than double the geas ritual’s rank

rituals.name: Glance of the Divine
rituals.notes: You ask that a divine being look upon you, calling their attention through offerings and supplication
rituals.cost: an offering of great personal value from each caster

rituals.name: Gnaw At The Moon
rituals.notes: It’s said that after his demise at the hands of jealous Fumeiyoshi , Tsukiyo’s corpse was left unguarded; this provided a humble matron‑rat opportunities to nibble at god flesh, a meal that transformed her into Lao Shu Po .
rituals.cost: mooncakes and rare tea worth 100 gp

rituals.name: Guardian's Aegis
rituals.notes: Guardian's aegis is a ritual used across numerous cultures to bind a chosen guardian and ward together so that they can complete a quest of great import.
rituals.cost: rare oils worth 10 gp × the primary caster’s level

rituals.name: Halt Death
rituals.notes: While death may be war’s stock and trade, you attempt to momentarily delay the inevitable.
rituals.cost: an hourglass filled with ebon sand, worth at least 10,000 gp

rituals.name: Harrowing
rituals.notes: The typical harrow reading does not magically manipulate fate, but when you perform a harrowing ritual to infuse a reading with occult power, you can impart real magical benefits to the target of the reading that give them agency and control over a task or goal in their immediate future.
rituals.cost: rare pigments and inks worth a total value of 20 gp × the target's level

rituals.name: Haven in the Ether
rituals.notes: You create an extradimensional haven that pierces through the overlapping planes.
rituals.cost: building materials worth 25,000 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism, or Crafting or Survival

rituals.name: Heartbond
rituals.notes: You officiate the creation of a magical bond between two or more willing creatures, who are secondary casters of the ritual and must share genuine affection for one another.
rituals.cost: sacramental beverages and a set of matching rings or other tokens worth 20 gp per secondary caster

rituals.name: Ideal Mimicry
rituals.notes: You craft a doll with care and quiet meditation on the target,
rituals.cost: crafting materials worth at least 50 gp × the target’s level; a lock of hair, nail clippings, or a vial of blood from the target

rituals.name: Imprisonment
rituals.notes: You perform a ritual to imprison a creature in one of several forms.
rituals.cost: reagents to construct the magical prison worth a total value of 800 gp × the target’s level

rituals.name: Incarnate Ancestry
rituals.notes: You attempt to reach back through time to make brief contact with one of the many past lives of the willing creature, then transform their current body to incarnate elements of that past life's ancestry into the present.

rituals.name: Inveigle
rituals.notes: You win over the target’s mind, causing it to see you as a close and trusted friend and look upon your every suggestion as reasonable.
rituals.cost: rare oils worth a total value of 10 gp × the target’s level
rituals.target: 1 creature of a level no greater than double the inveigle ritual’s rank

rituals.name: Kaiju Ward
rituals.notes: You protect a physical structure from the devastation caused by immense creatures.
rituals.secondaryCheck: Engineering Lore , Kaiju Lore, Survival , Warfare Lore

rituals.name: Labyrinthine Prison
rituals.notes: his ritual was developed by a long-dead minotaur hero-god whose cult trained to hunt and trap evil beings.
rituals.source: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
rituals.cost: fine paper and ink worth a total value of the target’s level × 25 gp

rituals.name: Last Night's Vigil
rituals.notes: Obscure folktales state on the first day of spring, the Mother of Secrets wanders Tian Xia to dispense blessings of health upon the elderly.
rituals.cost: rare sticks of incense worth 10 gp

rituals.name: Loyalty's Ward
rituals.notes: You place wards on a structure, creating a trap for those who would work against you.
rituals.cost: talismans written with rare inks worth 500 gp

rituals.name: Lucky Month
rituals.notes: You imbue the provided token with luck.
rituals.cost: Cost a favorite food or drink and a wearable token with personal or familial significance worth 10 gp total

rituals.name: Mind Swap
rituals.notes: This ritual allows two subjects to exchange minds, fully inhabiting one another's bodies.
rituals.cost: a pair of jeweled mirrors worth a total value of 50 gp × the level of the highest-level target
rituals.target: 2 creatures of the same ancestry, whose respective levels are no more than twice the rank of the ritual

rituals.name: Mindscape Door
rituals.notes: You project the targets into an immersive mindscape or cause them to exit one.
rituals.cost: incense and focusing diagrams worth a total value of the target's level (minimum 1) × 1 gp, for each target
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism, Deception or Diplomacy , Perception
rituals.target: yourself and up to 5 willing creatures

rituals.name: Mindscape Shift
rituals.notes: You attempt to transport the targets from a mindscape they’re currently within into an adjacent, nearly identical mindscape, such as to or from the Willowshore mindscape into Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape—the mindscape in which Governor Heh Shan-Bao is trapped.
rituals.cost: focusing diagrams and incense worth 28 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (expert) or Willowshore Lore
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana , Deception , Diplomacy , Occultism , Perception , or Willowshore Lore

rituals.name: Mosquito Blight
rituals.notes: You infest the area with tenacious, biting insects that disease and drain life from creatures in the area.
rituals.cost: amber and rare incense worth 750 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Nature (expert; you must be the Mosquito Witch )

rituals.name: Mother's Blessing
rituals.notes: You attempt to purify and stabilize the life inside of Ulgrem-Axaan's last remaining clutch of eggs.
rituals.cost: at least 1 gallon of clean river water

rituals.name: Mystic Carriage
rituals.notes: This ritual allows you and the other casters to conjure a magical carriage that transports you to a destination of your choice.
rituals.cost: toy carriage, horse statues, rare incense, and feathers worth at least 50 gp total

rituals.name: Oblivious Expulsion
rituals.notes: Severing ties with a member of a cult courts danger and threatens to undermine the secrecy of the group, whether that secrecy protects its worshippers or enables them to operate in the shadows.
rituals.cost: incense worth a total value of 150 gp

rituals.name: Ocean's Roar
rituals.notes: You invoke consciousness in a large body of water, such as a coastline, lake, or lagoon.
rituals.cost: 1 or more boats or ships worth a total of 10,000 gp
rituals.target: body of water no larger than a 7-mile radius area

rituals.name: Oil-Slicked Walls
rituals.notes: The outer walls are a city’s first defense against invaders, and you want to make certain no attackers can climb over them.
rituals.target: the outer walls of a settlement

rituals.name: Open the Wall of Ghosts
rituals.notes: Your research into the nature of the so-called Willowshore Curse has revealed a possible method of opening a doorway through the eerie Wall of Ghosts found west of town.
rituals.cost: rice grains and incense worth 60 gp

rituals.name: Owb Pact
rituals.notes: You call upon an owb to assist you in a goal.

rituals.name: Peer into the Past
rituals.notes: You recreate a moment in time that occurred within the past year, complete with all creatures present at the time.
rituals.cost: objects collected from the site worth 50 gp × spell’s rank × the primary caster’s level
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Religion, or Society or Survival

rituals.name: Perfection of Essence
rituals.notes: Many have pursued alchemical means to immortality, and most haven’t survived the attempt.
rituals.cost: special foods, herbs, and minerals worth a total value of 45,000 gp

rituals.name: Phantasmal Custodians
rituals.notes: You create a long-lasting adaptation of the phantasmal minion spell, forming entities to carry out basic tasks at a fixed location.
rituals.cost: rare oils, salts, and herbs worth a total value of 15 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (whichever isn’t used for the primary check), Diplomacy

rituals.name: Phantom Ship
rituals.notes: You create a link between a ship and an undead member of its crew to temporarily make the ship, and its passengers and crew, as incorporeal as ghosts .
rituals.cost: pearls or other gems worth a total value of 50 gp
rituals.target: 1 ship no more than 175 feet long

rituals.name: Plague Shot
rituals.notes: You imbue several pieces of siege weapon ammunition with an infectious disease that can bring an opposing force low over time.
rituals.target: 10 pieces of siege weapon ammunition, such as a ballista bolt or catapult stone

rituals.name: Planar Displacement
rituals.notes: You draw a ritual circle, and when the ritual is complete, you shift all creatures in the area to a different plane of existence.
rituals.cost: rare incense, precious metals, and purified chalk worth 500 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Lore (related to the destination plane), Survival

rituals.name: Planar Servitor
rituals.notes: You call upon a deity (or other divine power) to grant you aid in the form of a divine servitor of your deity’s choice.
rituals.cost: rare incense and offerings worth a total value of 2 gp × the spell rank × the target’s level, see text for more details

rituals.name: Plant Growth
rituals.notes: You cause the plants within the area to be healthier and more fruitful.

rituals.name: Portrait of Spite
rituals.notes: Using the blood, you compose a portrait of the target in perfect health.
rituals.cost: art supplies worth at least 100 gp × the target’s level and at least one pint of blood from the target
rituals.secondaryCheck: Crafting , Occultism or Religion (whichever isn't used for the primary check)

rituals.name: Power of the Beasts
rituals.notes: To simply kill the magical beasts who populate Tian Xia is needless and wasteful.
rituals.cost: bones, teeth, or claws of beasts worth 150 gp

rituals.name: Primal Call
rituals.notes: This functions as planar servitor except you craft a faerie circle and call an animal, beast, fey, fungus, or plant from within 100 miles.
rituals.cost: faerie circle ingredients worth a total value of 1 gp × the spell rank × the target’s level
rituals.target: 1 animal , beast , fey , fungus , or plant

rituals.name: Purify Soul Path
rituals.notes: You delve inward, spending extensive time contemplating the purity of your own soul and your past actions.
rituals.cost: rare incense and offerings worth a total value of 10 gp × your level

rituals.name: Purify Tanglebriar
rituals.notes: You call upon the primal presence of the Fierani Forest and the elven legacy of Kyonin in an attempt to purify a portion of the blighted realm of Tanglebriar.
rituals.source: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight
rituals.cost: rare incense and offerings worth a total value of 2,000 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana , Nature, Religion, Survival , or Tanglebriar Lore

rituals.name: Raga of Remembrance
rituals.notes: The song calls to the millions who died defending Vudra from Kothogaz, investing their power in Vanitapati, the legendary psychic.
rituals.cost: ceramics, incense, and pigments worth 100,000 gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Diplomacy or Performance ; Nature ; Religion or Society

rituals.name: Raise Runelord
rituals.notes: By drawing upon fragments of physical remains or treasured objects of a dead runelord and upon remnant energies of each runelord that live on after their deaths in the Dreamlands, this ritual creates a physical illusion of a long-dead runelord.
rituals.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
rituals.cost: gemstones worth 1,500 gp, fragments or significant items associated with the dead runelord;
rituals.target: 1 dead runelord who is not already active as a risen runelord

rituals.name: Ransack the Night
rituals.notes: When Fumeiyoshi was punished by the Celestial Court for deicide and fratricide, the rat who would become Lao Shu Po robbed the cangue-bound Fumeiyoshi of a sizable chunk of his shadow.
rituals.cost: blessed salt, citrus fruits (such as yuzu or limes), and rare spices worth 25 gp × the spell rank

rituals.name: Ravenous Reanimation
rituals.notes: You destroy the gathered treasures with a natural magical effect or spell, then invoke necromantic energies before you feed upon the charred and melted remains.
rituals.cost: valuable treasures from the target dragon’s hoard worth a total value of 50,000 gp

rituals.name: Recall Past Life
rituals.notes: You and the secondary casters spend 2 days drawing sigils on one another.
rituals.cost: 100 gp in special wine and symbolic herbs
rituals.target: the secondary caster who doesn't perform the Crafting check

rituals.name: Regale the Lost Ones
rituals.notes: Autumn’s shorter days herald an increase in hauntings, which only intensify during winter’s cold, dark nights.
rituals.cost: fees for opera actors, their meals, facial paint, costumes, incense, and offerings of alcohol, tobacco, and food for the lost ones with a total value of 2 gp × the spell rank × the settlement’s level
rituals.target: a settlement with a level equal to or lower than twice the ritual’s rank

rituals.name: Reincarnate
rituals.notes: You call forth the target’s soul and attempt to incarnate it into a brand-new body.
rituals.cost: rare herbs worth a total value of the target’s level (minimum 1) × 25 gp
rituals.target: 1 dead creature of up to 8th level

rituals.name: Reinforced Rations
rituals.notes: An army marches on its stomach, and a city under siege is often cut off from its normal food supplies, so preserving comestibles is of utmost importance during a prolonged conflict.
rituals.target: all food and drink in the area

rituals.name: Release the Ego to Restore the Soul
rituals.notes: You create abundant music and rally a crowd into a dance.
rituals.cost: incense and perfumes worth 20 gp × the spell’s rank

rituals.name: Resolute Obliteration
rituals.notes: You gather non-magical objects into your ritual circle and expose them to the forces of the Void.
rituals.cost: precious metals to create a ritual circle worth 10 gp × the ritual’s rank
rituals.target: up to 25 Bulk of non-magical items

rituals.name: Rest Eternal
rituals.notes: You call upon gods, spirits, and stranger beings to bar a creature’s spirit from ever returning.
rituals.cost: rare oils to anoint the body worth a total value of the target’s level (minimum 1) × 25 gp

rituals.name: Resurrect
rituals.notes: You attempt to call forth the target’s soul and return it to its body.
rituals.cost: gemstones worth a total value of 75 gp × the target’s level
rituals.target: 1 dead creature of up to 10th level

rituals.name: Retreat Among the Rains
rituals.notes: Ganhil developed this ritual to emulate the epiphanies and flowing mental states he experienced.
rituals.cost: at least 5 drops of water from a naturally occurring source (such as rainfall, rivers, or the seas) placed on the primary caster’s face

rituals.name: Rite of Repatriation
rituals.notes: You call upon and apologize to local spirits as you ritually return a culturally important object to its creators, heirs, or resting place.
rituals.cost: rare incense, offerings, or charitable donations to the rightful owners worth a total value of 5 gp × the target’s level (minimum 1 gp)
rituals.secondaryCheck: Occultism or Religion (whichever is used for the primary check), Diplomacy, Performance, Society, or a Lore corresponding to the rightful owners

rituals.name: Rite of the Blood Crown
rituals.notes: Using resources left behind by the cult of Droskar , King Merlokrep hopes to use this ritual to complete the Crown of the Kobold King
rituals.cost: blood sacrifice (see below)
rituals.target: the Crown of the Kobold King

rituals.name: Rite of the Red Star
rituals.notes: You invoke the latent power within the Doorway to the Red Star through repetitive chanting and ritual movements in an attempt to open a portal to the planet Akiton.
rituals.source: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star
rituals.secondaryCheck: DC 35 Arcana, Nature, Occultism , or Religion

rituals.name: Rolling Boulders
rituals.notes: You compel the very earth beneath your feet to rise and follow you.
rituals.cost: a precious gemstone worth 50 gp

rituals.name: Rune Trap
rituals.notes: You create a magical trap by binding a hostile spell into a rune.
rituals.cost: pigments and oils worth a total value of 5 gp × the rank of the spell to be stored
rituals.primaryCheck: Arcana (expert), Nature (expert), Occultism (expert), or Religion (expert) as determined by the tradition of spell cast in the ritual

rituals.name: Scuplt Appearance
rituals.notes: You permanently alter a creature's appearance, typically by sculpting new features by applying clay and coloring it with appropriate pigments.
rituals.cost: rare clay and pigments worth 20 gp × the rank of the ritual

rituals.name: Secure Siege Weapons
rituals.notes: You strengthen your army’s siege weapons and prevent them from being commandeered by enemy hands.
rituals.target: siege weapons operated by allied crews

rituals.name: Seed of Mercy
rituals.notes: You demonstrate your willingness to aid even the most helpless of life by nursing a small, injured bird to health and allowing it to fly away to freedom, earning in return the protection of the natural world.
rituals.cost: potent medicine valued at 200 gp

rituals.name: Separation
rituals.notes: You permanently separate two creatures from each other.
rituals.cost: protective emblems worth a total value of 5,000 gp

rituals.name: Shadow Double
rituals.notes: You create an illusory duplicate of the target creature by drawing shadowy material from the Netherworld and sculpting it into a semi-solid form.
rituals.cost: a small item of personal significance to the creature to be duplicated (such as an item of clothing they wear everyday or a memento of a romantic tryst), plus rare oils, minerals, and pigments with a total value of 300 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (master, the check has the secret trait)
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana , Nature , Occultism , Religion , or Society (whichever is required to Recall Knowledge about the creature being duplicated); Crafting ; Deception

rituals.name: Shround of Provinces
rituals.notes: By gathering dewdrops collected on a foggy morning, you can distill the essence of that fog and release it over a settlement.

rituals.name: Sky Signs
rituals.notes: You emblazon a message across the sky itself.
rituals.cost: lenses and fine mineral dusts worth 300 gp total

rituals.name: Sleepless Season
rituals.notes: You attempt to inflict a curse of sleeplessness upon individuals in the target area to weaken their resolve, possibly making it easier to conquer them.
rituals.cost: an amethyst pendant worth at least 75 gp

rituals.name: Song of Silver
rituals.notes: The Song of Silver is a potent and powerful ritual whose magic is inexorably tied to the city of Kintargo.

rituals.name: Split Shadow
rituals.notes: You create a shadow double of the target by drawing energy directly from the Shadow Plane into a mirror and shaping it into an exact, quasi-real duplicate.
rituals.cost: Cost a precious possession or drop of blood from the creature to be duplicated, plus an ornate silver mirror worth 7,000 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (master, the check has the secret trait)

rituals.name: Sprawling Tunnels
rituals.notes: You spill the ink on an accurate map of the area, which transforms into a series of lines that correspond to a new network of tunnels under the earth.
rituals.cost: fine ink worth 50 gp

rituals.name: Statuette
rituals.notes: This ritual is a variant of the shrink item spell that allows for the transformation of significantly larger items
rituals.target: 1 freestanding, non-magical object no larger than 3,000 cubic feet (the size of a Huge creature)

rituals.name: Still Life Storage
rituals.notes: As you paint, you transform objects into a still life painting.
rituals.cost: a primed canvas and paints worth the highest target’s level × 10 gp
rituals.target: up to 15 Bulk of non-magical objects that can fit in a 20-foot cube

rituals.name: Summerland Spell
rituals.notes: The ritual dramatically dampens harsh weather around Hillcross, causing the temperature of the area to move up to two categories closer to normal
rituals.cost: 1,000 gp worth of precious stones ground to dust
rituals.secondaryCheck: Performance , Religion , Society , Mammoth Lord Lore or a similar Lore skill, Survival

rituals.name: Supreme Connection
rituals.notes: In a show of power, you call forth a powerful entity in front of a crowd of onlookers, forcing the entity to manifest and answer your questions.
rituals.cost: rare perfume worth 250 gp

rituals.name: Sweetest Solstice
rituals.notes: On long winter nights, many families in Tian Xia share a dish of glutinous rice balls.
rituals.cost: sesame paste, sugar, rice balls, food dye, cooking pots, and utensils with a total value of 2 gp × the spell rank × the settlement’s level
rituals.target: a settlement with a level equal to or lower than twice the ritual’s rank

rituals.name: Tattoo Whispers
rituals.notes: You carefully tattoo the same design upon each secondary caster, which grants the ability to communicate over distances
rituals.cost: tattoo inks and silver tattooing needles worth 20 gp for each secondary caster

rituals.name: Teleportation Circle
rituals.notes: You create a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground, which acts as a portal to a destination determined at the time of the ritual.
rituals.cost: rare incense, precious metals, and purified chalk worth 500 gp

rituals.name: Terminate Bloodline
rituals.notes: Bestow the target with a wasting disease that is contagious to their family members
rituals.source: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands
rituals.cost: a bodily sample from the target, and valuables belonging to the target worth a total value of 100 gp × the spell level × the target's level
rituals.target: 1 creature of a level no greater than double the terminate bloodline ritual's level

rituals.name: The Unseeing Blade Master
rituals.notes: There are many legends of blade masters who, not wanting to rely on flawed mortal eyes, learned to fight through reliance on both their other keen senses and knowledge from the universe itself.
rituals.cost: rare incense worth 1,500 gp

rituals.name: The World's a stage
rituals.notes: This famous ritual is a sophisticated example of symbolic magic, binding fate and fortune to follow a prepared script.
rituals.cost: costumes and a stage large enough to fit all casters

rituals.name: Transmigrate
rituals.notes: A slain creature whose soul became trapped between life and death in the Willowshore mindscape can’t escape either back to life or into the afterlife.
rituals.cost: heron feathers, incense, and specially prepared sakaki wood
rituals.secondaryCheck: Crafting , Nature , Society , or Willowshore Lore

rituals.name: Unbearable Cacophony
rituals.notes: You amplify the sound of every item and creature to impossible levels.
rituals.cost: valuable crystals and tuning forks worth 300 gp

rituals.name: Uncouple Memory
rituals.notes: Some knowledge cannot persist in the world and haunts those who possess it.
rituals.cost: surgical supplies worth 400 gp

rituals.name: Unsealing of Secrets
rituals.notes: You place the writing instruments on the parchment while you call upon a spirit to answer your questions.
rituals.cost: fine inks, pens, and papers worth 150 gp

rituals.name: Unseen Heralds
rituals.notes: The ritual works by placing several simple illusions throughout the area, allowing the caster to transmit their voice throughout the area.
rituals.cost: rare oils, salts, and herbs worth a total value of 15gp
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana or Occultism (whichever isn't used for the primary check), Diplomacy

rituals.name: Vital Singularity
rituals.notes: When several companions or followers have reached a point of undying love and trust in you, they might be willing to die to save your life.
rituals.cost: crushed rubies worth 2,000 gp

rituals.name: Void Harvest
rituals.notes: The sky darkens over the affected area and the air becomes oppressive as you open a direct conduit to the Void , a plane of vast nothingness.

rituals.name: Ward Domain
rituals.notes: This ritual has long been used to guard the private sanctums of powerful rulers, spellcasters, and other figures of import.
rituals.cost: rare incenses, oils, and powdered silver, worth 150 gp total

rituals.name: Waters of Prediction
rituals.notes: You and the secondary casters peer into the still waters of a natural pool or lake to divine your collective future.
rituals.source: The Waters of Stone Ring Pond
rituals.cost: rare incense and herbs worth a total value of 300 gp
rituals.primaryCheck: Nature or Religion (master, the check has the secret trait)

rituals.name: Wild Allegiance
rituals.notes: You approach, feed, and commune with the most notably hostile beasts in an effort to forge a true friendship and allegiance with the natural world.
rituals.cost: animal food worth a total value of 150 gp

rituals.name: Wild Feast
rituals.notes: You draw forth latent hostility in the local flora and fauna.

rituals.name: Winter's Breath
rituals.notes: The cold and dour months of winter are an excellent time to gather with friends and family to enjoy a pot of hot tea.
rituals.cost: 15 gp

rituals.name: Wish
rituals.notes: You weave the fabric of reality itself to grant the target’s greatest desire.
rituals.cost: fine ash, magically imbued pigments, and a gem in a marquise cut worth 100,000 gp in total

rituals.name: World In Shadow
rituals.notes: This ritual must be cast at night, at which point darkness becomes everlasting.
rituals.secondaryCheck: Arcana, Nature, Occultism, Religion (cannot be the same skill as for the primary check)
